findings.guidelineQuote: A require in a view is a finding.
findings.title: View requires a module
findings.body: The view requires the totals module; the model should carry the count.

findings.guidelineQuote: A computation that produces new data in a view is a finding.
findings.title: View derives a color flag from facet ids
findings.body: The view searches facet ids to classify them; the model should provide the flag.
